At the supplied eta0, target/scene parameters p are fitted. Then one joint bound-clamped Gauss-Newton step for(p,eta) is computed using target rows, field-profile rows, and both declared prior rows, with the common1e-10relative singular-value cutoff on dimensionless columns. The positive PSF, scene, target residuals and re-fitted field nuisance residuals are actually re-evaluated at the accepted alpha=1iterate. RAW nonlinear field likelihood, not projected residual norm, controls line search.

covariance_estimands.field_only_cut: H_p=A^T A+P_a^T P_a; V_p|eta=H_p^-1; T=-H_p^-1 A^T B; V_p,cut=V_p|eta+T V_eta,field T^T. V_eta,field includes4actualfieldstamps+eta/.2prior with fieldpointnuisance profiling. Target pixels do not condition eta in this cut baseline.
covariance_estimands.joint_provisional: V_joint=(J_joint^T J_joint)^-1 on the specified dimensionless SVD measured subspace, at the actual one-step updated mean. It is UNCONSTRAINED local curvature, not a converged nonlinear posterior, positive-bound/truncated posterior, or coverage guarantee. Rank414/414 means this particular linearization has no SVD-null columns; supplied priors contribute rank.
covariance_estimands.moment: Three conventions are saved: raw fitted q; q+FULL finite-grid moment(P); q+moment(P)-moment(positive_base). The last matches the delivered relative-moment convention. Analytic dmoment/deta is included in the full covariance. These conventions do not establish physical centroid accuracy.
covariance_estimands.sky_geometry: Exact archived nonlinear GWCS and intrinsic-coordinate Jacobians propagate the full centroid covariance, retaining shared-response cross-image and cross-exposure blocks. The normalized positive ePSF and finite observed-sky scene are declared conditional inputs.

remaining_dependencies: The coarse positive field-response+minimalcoherent-sky mean fails absolute nativepixel adequacy in both fitted and whole-held-target exposure applications. The missing instrument/scene mean response has not been identified by reducing rawchi2.

One accepted coupled step is an actual provisional iterate. Full nonlinear convergence and response calibration remain unestablished. The reported maximum unconstrained scaled gradient includes active positive-sky directions, so it is not by itself a projectedKKT convergence statistic.
13all-data and14training sky coefficients sit atzero. Their reported covariance is localunconstrainedcurvature, not an exact nonnegative-coefficient posterior.

Four17x17fieldstamps can constrain a regularized318coefficient localfamily numerically, but this is not independent transfer validation. Target sky covers only four finite patches; extended source/foreground galaxy decomposition and broad diffuse light remain nonunique.

The nativeCAL products and compact fieldhistory do not determine actual target65x65 per-read electron histories and pixel-specific slope weights. history_rate requires those actual arrays. No targethistory, gain-aware electroncharge transfer coefficient, or unconsumed observation is fabricated.

This optical readout application does not derive the microscopic j_c=mu/2 sum_s[U_s^dagger(iG_c)U_s-V_s^dagger(iG_c)V_s] or its dressed statistical state kernel. It neither replaces it by a classical effective current nor uses old retarded arrays/native heat as a statistical kernel. No Wick factorization, occupation closure,2000fm target substitution, or extra BHSM amplitude is introduced.
